alignment.name: tone & language rules
alignment.why: No tone or language rule hits (TON-*, LNG-*) and nothing against the brand's stated philosophy. Other policy findings count in compliance, not here.

alignment.name: Meta voice match
alignment.why: Measured against 10 long-running brand copies and 8 top statics (meta_voice_profile.json, built 2026-10-05): sentence length 100 — median 5 words per sentence vs the brand's 7 (middle half 4–9); exclamation marks 100 — 0 per 100 words vs the brand's 0.6; emoji 100 — 0 per 100 words vs the brand's 0.6; hype words 100 — none (0/100 words vs the brand's 0.2); fear / problem words 100 — none (0/100 words vs the brand's 0.4); ingredient / % first 100 — opens with an active or a concentration (as the brand does in 37% of its openers); hook type 100 — opening hook reads as "ingredient led" (20% of the brand's long-running copies).

alignment.name: transparency & no exaggeration
alignment.why: shows the active's strength, as the brand does.

alignment.name: on-image text budget
alignment.why: 23 words on the image (brand's single statics: 13 median, 21 max; limit used 21), headline 5 word(s). Over budget: 23 words on the image (limit 21). Counts words only; layout, white space and product size are not seen by this score.

alignment.name: AI judge tone read
alignment.why: Calm, factual and ingredient-led for Light Fluid SPF 50 Sunscreen, with no fear, hype or urgency; the study basis is stated plainly.

win.name: format / template
win.why: Format "Stat-led creative" (given (ctx.template_id)): 2 of 2 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 67% of 122). Shrunk towards that base rate; small group, read as a direction only.

win.why: 23 words on the image (21–35 words; headline + on-image text, footnote not counted): 19 of 27 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 80% of 74). Shrunk towards that base rate.
